recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-7370 unless the work group reopens broader narrative generation policy.
issue_request: FHIR-7370 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core narrative clarification from the DSTU1 ballot asking how generated resource narrative can avoid redundant referenced-resource summaries in lists, documents, or multi-resource contexts. The approved resolution was to add a note that systems may generate narrative intelligently but SHALL NOT assume any particular rendering context.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 209b86b3855c85093735f059ae3be5ce06855664, the git-svn mirror of svn revision 6212 cited in the Jira comment. That commit added the current SHALL NOT assume-context guidance to source/narrative.html.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists narrative.html and its related pages, confirming the checked page is current build/navigation input. Later FHIR-17463 normative-language cleanup touched the same section and preserved the FHIR-7370 sentence as normative guidance. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already carries the approved requirement, so adding further list/document-specific prose would be redundant rather than a necessary current-spec correction.

related_jiras.note: Later Published normative-language cleanup on the same narrative page split the FHIR-7370 paragraph but preserved the SHALL NOT assume-context requirement.
